summary: Tested Staff/Volontari unification end-to-end in TEST org. Backend 8/8 pytest pass: CF lookup (Roma H501, Z404 Stati Uniti estero, invalid, omocodia L->0, historical Abano vs Abano Terme), auth 401 on anagrafica endpoints, places status enabled:false + 503 for autocomplete/detail, public availability submit (no auth) creates person with luogo_nascita from CF + ONE da_classificare staff link + provenienza link_disponibilita + preferenze/days; resubmits don't duplicate person/link; PUT /staff categoria staff -> is_da_classificare false, provenienza unchanged; resubmit after classification does not recreate da_classificare. Frontend: Da classificare tab badge count, orange badge for Mario Rossi, PersonMask (no LinkedIn/Foto, luogo_nascita, read-only computed Età updating on DOB change, CF hint + autofill + confirm-before-overwrite, invalid CF hint, Google fallback message, manual address editable, provenienza read-only, prefs with days, Da classificare option), classify -> Staff moves row to Staff tab; Aggiungi Staff / Aggiungi Volontario create persons via same mask with correct default category; Events 'Disponibilità' dialog shows only public link, no tabs, avail-go-staff navigates; mobile 390px list + mask usable (no horizontal overflow, sticky Save). One real bug: overwrite confirm fires twice.

minor.issue: When a person resubmits with a different preference, availability.preferenza_attivita is updated (preferenze shows 'Tecnico') but the existing staff link keeps old preferenza ('Hostess') because ensure_link returns early if link exists. Staff list Preferenza column then shows stale value.

Only structural regex validation; check character (16th) is not validated (e.g. RSSMRA80A01Z404U accepted as valid). Public submit does validate via _cf_valid, so the mask can accept a CF that the public form would reject.
No cascade: staff links and availabilities for the deleted person remain orphaned (pre-existing generic CRUD behaviour).
Idempotency is check-then-insert with no unique index on (org_id, persona_id, evento_id); concurrent submissions could create duplicates.

ui_bugs.issue: window.confirm('Il luogo di nascita attuale è ... Vuoi sostituirlo?') is shown TWICE per CF entry. Root cause: confirm() is called inside the setData updater function; React.StrictMode (index.js) double-invokes updaters. Fix: read current data.luogo_nascita outside the updater (e.g. use a ref/current data), decide with confirm once, then setData with plain object.

issues: Tabs wrap: 'Turni' drops to a second line inside the tab bar
Ruolo select option text 'Da classificare — scegli Staff o Volontario' truncated in mask on mobile
Data di nascita uses native browser date input instead of shadcn calendar/date picker

In ensure_link (or pub_avail_submit) update existing link's preferenza when it is still da_classificare / when submitted preference changes

Mobile: prevent tab wrap on Staff/Volontari (horizontal scroll) and shorten Da classificare option label
